title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Zoe Khan
content:
TL;DR:
- Working scratchpad for SOC2 readiness notes, control mapping drafts, and open questions to bring to weekly evidence sync.
- Focus areas: Access Controls, Change Management, Logging & Monitoring, Incident Response, Data Classification & Encryption.

Notes to self / context:
- Auditor intro call scheduled w/ RSM on 2026-03-05. Need initial evidence bundle by 2026-02-29 (we missed by a day, but final must be prepared by next checkpoint).
- Primary owners should be listed next to each control mapping line. If no owner, mark as P0 to assign.
- Drive doc will be source-of-truth for quick notes; final mappings will go into Confluence and link to JIRA/Linear tickets for evidence collection.

Outstanding risks / quick hits:
- IAM: We don’t yet have a clear export of inactive accounts older than 90 days across all orgs (aws + gcp + okta).
  - Mitigation: run scripts, ask infra for historical report. Owner: Ryan Chen. Ticket: SEC-230.
- Change mgmt: release notes exist but not always linked to JIRA ticket IDs in the release archive for 2024 Q3.
  - Risk: insufficient traceability for change approvals.
  - Mitigation: retro-link PRs to tickets where possible, start enforcing PR template. Owner: Lena Morales.
- Monitoring/Alerts: some SLO alert runbooks are in ops but not consistently in PagerDuty escalation policies.
  - Owner: Oliver Park.

Draft control mapping (text table - update before Confluence import):
- CC1.1 (Logical Access): Okta SSO + MFA enforced for all employees -> evidence: Okta policy screenshot (okta-policies-2026-02.png), MFA enforcement report (missing historical export). Owner: Maya Singh.
- CC2.3 (Change Control): PR -> peer review -> CI -> deployment; evidence: Jenkins pipeline logs, PR review history (github-prs-archive.csv). Owner: Lena Morales.
- CC3.2 (System Logging): Centralized logs in ELK + Cloudwatch exports; evidence: log-retention-policy.pdf, sample logs for 2026-01-15 (elb-access.log.gz). Owner: Ryan Chen.
- CC4.5 (Incident Response): IR playbook v0.9 (in Confluence), table top notes (2025-10-10) -> evidence: tabletop-summary.pdf (needs redaction). Owner: James Kim.
- CC5.1 (Encryption): Encryption at rest for prod models and object store: KMS keys in use; evidence: KMS policy snippets, S3 bucket encryption config (s3-configs.csv). Owner: Zoe Khan.

Evidence inventory (current):
- Available: Confluence IR playbook, Okta policy screenshot, GitHub PR exports (last 6 months), sample ELK logs (retention demonstrated).
- Partial/missing: Historical MFA enforcement exports, inactive account listing >90 days, complete release-ticket linkage for 2024-Q3, signed vendor contracts for two smaller vendors (analytics SDK).

Open questions for auditor / things to clarify on call:
1) Auditor wants continuous control samples - do they accept sampling from last 6 months or want rolling 12 months for certain controls?
2) For vendor management, what level of evidence is enough for low-risk third parties? Signed contract + security questionnaire or need SOC2 report from vendor?
3) For change control, can we provide PR-to-deploy trace for a sample of releases (they said 5 releases)? Need to confirm sample size on call.

Action items (short-term):
- [ ] Ask infra to run inactive-account report across aws/gcp/okta (Ryan) - due 2026-02-20 (overdue).
- [ ] Export MFA enforcement logs from Okta (Maya) - due 2026-02-25.
- [ ] Create JIRA tickets to link missing PRs to releases (Lena) - backlog work, aim to close 50% by 2026-03-15.
- [ ] Redact PII from tabletop notes before sharing with auditor (James) - due 2026-02-26.
- [ ] Confirm auditor sampling requirements in intro call (Zoe) - prepare suggested sample list.

Meeting notes (2026-02-22 sync):
- Maya: Okta can produce CSV but need API token; will coordinate with IT compliance to handle export cadence.
- Ryan: ELK retention policy is set to 180 days for prod logs; need to provide policy doc and sample exports.
- Lena: Suggested we retro-link PRs by adding a bot to auto-update release notes; created automation backlog ticket.
- Oliver: PagerDuty escalation missing in some services; will audit PD policies and update runbooks.

Quick prompts / text snippets to use elsewhere:
- "Evidence package includes access control exports, change control traces (PR->merge->deploy), sample logs, IR tabletop notes, and encryption configuration snapshots."
- "Control mapping is a living doc - use Confluence for canonical mapping and reference this scratchpad for context and open questions."

Next steps before auditor call:
- Pull together zip of currently available items (Okta screenshot, sample logs, PR exports, IR playbook) and upload to secure share.
- Draft 1-pager for auditor summarizing what's available vs missing and expected timeline to close gaps.
- Confirm owners are assigned in Linear/JIRA with due dates and reminders.

Notes to self: keep this informal. Move finalized mappings to Confluence under /SEC/SOC2+Control+Mapping and close loop w/ compliance team.

Misc. reminders: link to SOC2 checklist in Confluence, update tags on final doc, run one dry-run evidence handoff with auditor rep (ask for their sample checklist).

---
End of scratchpad (will consolidate into Confluence after next sync).
